/narrative.1: The programme main goal is to improve food security, family nutrition and incomes for about 62 000 poor farming households in Amhara, Oromia, Tigrai and SNNPR regional states. Its primary objective is to develop a sustainable, farmer-owned and managed, system of small-scale irrigated agriculture. This objective will be realised mainly through the empowerment of farmers and their participation in the design, construction and operation and maintenance of the irrigation schemes,underpinned by improved agricultural support services and institutions strengthening at all levels, particularly at grassroots.
